quotation: Give all your worries and cares to God, for he cares about you.
God is light; there is no darkness in him.
God knows his plans for us—plans that offer hope and a future.
Trust God wholeheartedly rather than relying only on your own understanding.
Be still and recognise that God is God.
Christ gives us the strength we need.
Everything we do should be done with love.
God's word provides light and guidance for our path.
Don't be afraid: God is with us and gives us strength.
Jesus invites the weary and burdened to come to him for rest.
The Lord is our shepherd and provides what we need.
Do what is right, love mercy and walk humbly with God.
Jesus is the light of the world; following him leads to life.
God loved the world so much that he gave his Son.
Jesus declares himself to be the resurrection and the life.
Jesus is not in the tomb—he has risen.
Nothing can separate us from God's love.
This day comes from the Lord; rejoice and be glad in it.
Jesus tells his followers that they are the light of the world.
Jesus is the way, the truth and the life.
The Holy Spirit gives Jesus' followers power to be his witnesses.
The Spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness and other good fruit.
Trusting God fills us with joy, peace and overflowing hope.
We can praise God because we are wonderfully made.
Seek God's kingdom above everything else.
Instead of worrying, pray about everything and experience God's peace.
Find joy in the Lord and entrust your desires to him.
Let your light shine so that others see the good you do and glorify God.
Be strong and courageous because God is with you wherever you go.
Our help ultimately comes from the Lord, maker of heaven and earth.
Above everything else, put on love, which binds people together.
Jesus Christ remains the same yesterday, today and forever.
We are God's workmanship, created in Christ to do good works.
The Lord is good; his love and faithfulness continue through generations.
Jesus promises his presence when people gather in his name.
Rejoice in hope, be patient through trouble and continue praying.
It is beautiful when God's people live together in unity.
Those who trust in the Lord receive renewed strength.
Give thanks to God because he is good and his faithful love continues.
Everything that is good ultimately comes as a gift from God.
Allow Christ's peace to rule in your hearts and live thankfully.
Come joyfully before God with worship and thanksgiving.
Love God wholeheartedly and love your neighbour as yourself.
Jesus commands his followers to love one another as he has loved them.
The Lord is our light and salvation, so we need not live in fear.
When we are afraid, we can put our trust in God.
Thank God wholeheartedly and tell of the wonderful things he has done.
Love one another genuinely and take delight in honouring others.
A child is given to us—the promised ruler whose names reveal who he is.
Nothing is impossible with God.
The angel announces wonderful news of great joy: the Saviour has been born.
God's light shines in the darkness, and darkness cannot overcome it.
